messages:
incident-bot: [P1] Pager: high-error-rate /api/generate in eu-west-1 - 50% 5xx, alerting #eng-oncall. Incident link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-1723

incident-bot: Auto-detection: spike started at 2024-11-12T22:20:34Z. Suggested runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/scalable/latency-5xx

Alex R.: taking primary. Oncall here, starting mitigation runbook now. I'll post actions + timestamps.

Maya Patel: I can shadow for the next 4h (EST night). If you need a handoff around 00:00 UTC ping me. :thumbsup:

Jamal Singh: CS report — two tickets from AcmeCorp (eu-west customers) showing 500s. Do we know blast radius?

Priya N.: running quick checks. Command: `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=serving -o wide`
```
# sample output
serving-0  Ready 2/2  2/2  92m  10.0.1.12
serving-1  Ready 1/2  1/2  55m  10.0.1.14
serving-2  CrashLoopBackOff 0/2  0/2  3m  10.0.1.17
```

Priya N.: logs show repeated OOM-ish failures around the model binder: `OOM killed process` and `kv cache miss flood`.

Sofia L.: suggesting two immediate mitigations: scale up replicas + route traffic to eu-west-2 fallback region if available. See runbook step 4 (link above).

Alex R.: scaling replicas now: `rctl scale --cluster eu-west-1 --service serving --replicas 6` -> started at 1739551258.

incident-bot: Action noted: scaling event detected (user: Alex R.). Monitoring for reduction in error-rate. Next automated check in 2m.

Priya N.: I applied a temporary routing rule to shift new requests to eu-west-2 for 10% of traffic: `routectl create --from eu-west-1 --to eu-west-2 --sample 10 --condition "5xx_rate>3"` - rule id r-93a4.

Maya Patel: If we plan a handoff, can we ensure CS escalation assigned? Jamal to be first contact. Also please add a short status message in #support-updates.

Jamal Singh: I'll take CS contact. Reached out to AcmeCorp CSM to let them know we're mitigating and will follow up in 30m. Tickets SC-4421 & SC-4422.

Sofia L.: metrics snapshot post-actions (15s interval):
```
metric: error_rate (eu-west-1)
before: 48.7%
after scale+route: 2.1%
cache_hit_ratio: 12% -> 67%
latency_p95: 1.2s -> 420ms
```

Alex R.: good signal. Keeping on-call for 30m observation window. If error_rate stays <2% for 15m, move to P2.

Maya Patel: I can take the midnight->04:00 UTC chunk if you need to hand off. My timezone +5. Please put explicit notes in the runbook: actions done, rule id, runbook step completed.

Alex R.: documented state in incident channel: 
- mitigations: scaled replicas at 1739551258, route r-93a4 applied at 1739551271
- active symptoms: intermittent 500s on heavy KV-cache miss paths
- next checks: 1739551340, 1739551400
- escalation: Jamal (CS)

incident-bot: Reminder: attach logs to the incident ticket and tag postmortem owner. Use `incident-bot attach logs --since 2024-11-12T22:15:00Z`

Priya N.: ran collection: `incident-tools collect --service serving --since 22:10Z --out /tmp/INC-1723-logs.tar.gz` (uploaded to incident link).

Jamal Singh: Customer impact summary for postmortem: AcmeCorp - ~3% of their requests failed, two support tickets, no SLA violation yet but user frustration. Recommend outreach + credit offer if they escalate.

Sofia L.: note for follow-up: investigate KV-cache warmup sequence and memory thresholds. Consider increasing resident set for model binder or enable progressive warmup.

Alex R.: if I need to hand off to Maya, I'll leave the following: 
`Handoff checklist:`
- current mitigation active (scale + route)
- rule id r-93a4, created at 1739551271
- logs uploaded to incident link
- CS contact: Jamal
- runbook steps 1-4 completed

Maya Patel: acknowledged. If you handoff, drop a short summary with the three most recent checks + any flaky pods. I can take primary at 1739551400 UTC if needed.

incident-bot: Auto-update: error_rate eu-west-1 = 0.8% (sampled 30s) at 1739551310.

Alex R.: resolving P1 -> P2. Error rate steady <1% for 5 consecutive samples. Will monitor for 30m then close incident. Postmortem owner: Sofia L.

Maya Patel: thanks team. I'll be available if it creeps back up. Please file a short ops note in the runbook about the fallback rule config. :memo:

Jamal Singh: I'll follow up with AcmeCorp and update tickets.

incident-bot: Incident INC-1723 note: status changed to MONITORING at 1739551315.

Alex R.: closing thread here; final check at 1739551600 and then archive. Good job everyone. :tada:
